callouts.title: Cauchy-Condensation-test
callouts.body: 序列$a_n$不增，非负，那么级数$\sum_{n\geq1}a_n$的收敛发散性质等价于$\sum_{k}2^ka_{2^k}$的收敛发散性。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n$ be a nonincreasing, nonnegative sequence. Then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ converges if and only if the series $\sum_k 2^k a_{2^k}$ converges.

callouts.title: 对非负不增序列部分和做Dyadic分解的基本想法
callouts.body: 对于部分和$\sum_{n\geq N}a_n$其中被求和对象，序列$a_n$不增，非负，那么我们可以对自然数的子集$\{1,...,N\}$做Dyadic分解，把这个集合分解为$M_N = \lfloor\log_2^{N}\rfloor$段形如$$\{2^k,...,2^{k+1}-1\}$$的集合(其中$k\in \{0,...,M_N-1\}$)，以及一段$\{2^{M_N},...,N\}$.于是$$\sum_{n\leq N}a_n=\sum_{k=0}^{M_N-1}\sum_{2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}}a_n+R_N$$于是我们可以对每一段$\sum_{2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}}a_n$做简单的估计从而估计整个部分和。

classification_result.english_title: Basic Idea of Dyadic Decomposition for Partial Sums of Nonnegative Nonincreasing Sequences

if_strategy_template.summary_en: For a nonnegative nonincreasing sequence, split the index set into dyadic blocks $\{2^k,\dots,2^{k+1}-1\}$ and estimate the contribution of each block separately. This converts a partial sum into a sum of easily comparable pieces.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when estimating partial sums of nonnegative monotone sequences, especially in condensation-style arguments and blockwise comparison tests.

callouts.title: 命题2.1:积分的凝聚判别法
callouts.body:
设函数$f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：
1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[a,b]\subset [1,+\infty)$上都是黎曼可积的。
2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。

那么广义积分$\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$收敛。

---

设函数$f:(0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：
1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[a,b]\subset (0,1]$上都是黎曼可积的。
2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。

那么广义积分$\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^{-n} f(2^{-n})$收敛。

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy: (1) $f$ is locally integrable on $[1,+\infty)$; (2) $f$ is nonnegative and nonincreasing on this interval. Then the improper integral $\int_1^{+\infty} f(x)\,dx$ converges if and only if the series $\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty} 2^n f(2^n)$ converges.

Also, let $f:(0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy: (1) $f$ is locally integrable on $(0,1]$; (2) $f$ is nonnegative and nonincreasing on this interval. Then the improper integral $\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx$ converges if and only if the series $\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty} 2^{-n} f(2^{-n})$ converges.

callouts.title: 命题2.2
callouts.body: 设$(X,\mu)$为测度空间，$1\leq p<\infty$。对可测函数$f$有$$f\in L^p \iff \sum_{k\in \mathbb{Z}} 2^{kp}\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>2^k\})<\infty$$

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $(X,\mu)$ be a measure space and let $1\leq p<\infty$. For a measurable function $f$, one has
$$f\in L^p \iff \sum_{k\in \mathbb{Z}} 2^{kp}\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>2^k\})<\infty.$$

callouts.title: 想法2.3
callouts.body: 有的时候我们也并不是一定需要对整个积分做基于dyadic分解的放缩，我们可以只对其中某部分进行这样的操作。毕竟要求整个被积函数单调，这个条件还是太强了一些。我们可以稍微推广一下之前的估计方法，如果我们可以把被积函数看成是$\omega(t)f(t)$的形式，其中$f(t)$依旧拥有单调性以及非负性，而$\omega(t)f(t)$不一定具有单调性，但是具有非负性。那么我们可以只针对$f$，利用单调性进行放缩，把$\omega$单纯看成是积分的某种权重函数，这样也可以得到一个广义上的同阶的级数。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Partial dyadic decomposition with a weight
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When the whole integrand is not monotone, rewrite it as $\omega(t)f(t)$ where $f(t)$ remains nonnegative and monotone. Apply dyadic estimates only to $f$, while treating $\omega$ as a weight, to derive a comparable series criterion.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when studying improper integrals whose integrands are nonnegative but not fully monotone, yet admit a factorization into a monotone part times a weight.

callouts.title: 命题2.4
callouts.body: 函数$f:[0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$单调不减，且非负，并且满足$$\int_0^1 \frac{f(t)}{t}\,dt<\infty$$那么一定有$f(t)\to 0$。

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f:[0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$ be nonnegative and nondecreasing, and suppose that
$$\int_0^1 \frac{f(t)}{t}\,dt<\infty.$$Then necessarily $f(t)\to 0$.

callouts.title: 例子3.3
callouts.body: 已知正实数序列$a_n$是单调增加的，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{1}{a_n}$是收敛的，证明$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{n}{a_1+\cdots+a_n}$也是收敛的。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n$ be a positive real sequence that is increasing, and suppose that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{1}{a_n}$ converges. Prove that $\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{n}{a_1+\cdots+a_n}$ also converges.
